slides.title: Weak Prompts, Weak Answers
content: A weak prompt gets a weak answer.
A strong prompt gets a smart answer.
slides.narration:
Have you ever got a strange answer from an AI?
That's because of a weak prompt.
A weak prompt gets a weak answer.
A strong prompt gets a smart answer.
slides.image_prompt: Person at a laptop, looking confused at a screen displaying generic text. A thought bubble above their head with a question mark.

slides.title: The 3 C's of Prompting
content: Clarity
Context
Constraints
slides.narration:
The best prompts have three key ingredients.
We call them the 3 C's.
They are Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Let's explore each one.
slides.image_prompt: Infographic showing three interconnected circles labeled Clarity, Context, and Constraints.

slides.title: 1. Clarity: Be Specific!
content: The AI doesn't know what you're thinking.
Vague prompts lead to generic, unhelpful answers.
slides.narration:
First, let's talk about Clarity.
Clarity means being specific.
The AI can't read your mind.
Vague prompts give generic answers.
So, you need to be clear.
slides.image_prompt: A magnifying glass highlighting the word 'Clarity'. An AI robot shrugging, looking confused.

slides.title: Clarity: Weak Prompt Example
content: Weak Prompt: "Write about electric cars."
slides.narration:
Let's see a weak prompt example.
Type 'Write about electric cars.' into your AI tool.
See the generic output?
It's not very helpful.
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording: User types 'Write about electric cars' into an AI chat interface and submits. AI generates a generic, broad paragraph about electric cars.

slides.title: Clarity: Good Prompt Example
content: Good Prompt (Clear): "Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
Now, let's make it clear.
We'll add specific details.
Let's try this prompt.
'Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits.
This is for owning an electric car.
It is for someone living in a city.'
See how much better the output is?
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording: User types the improved clear prompt into the AI chat. AI generates a focused blog post about urban electric car benefits. Show a quick side-by-side comparison of weak vs. clear output.

slides.title: 2. Context: Give Background!
content: Context tells the AI why you're asking.
It helps the AI adopt the right perspective.
slides.narration:
Next, let's add Context.
Context gives the AI background.
It tells the AI why you're asking.
It also tells who the audience is.
This helps the AI adopt a perspective.
slides.image_prompt: An AI robot surrounded by thought bubbles containing background information, like a target audience icon and a 'why' question mark.

slides.title: Context: Better Prompt Example
content: Good Prompt: "Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
Better Prompt (with Context): "Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
Let's take our clear prompt.
Now, add context to it.
We'll specify the blog type.
Try this prompt.
'Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog.
It focuses on sustainable living.
Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car.
This is for someone living in a city.'
Notice the improved tone and focus.
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording: User modifies the previous clear prompt by adding 'for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living.' AI generates output tailored for that specific blog type.

slides.title: 3. Constraints: Set the Rules!
content: Constraints are boundaries that shape the output.
Tell the AI the length, format, and style you need.
slides.narration:
Finally, let's add Constraints.
Constraints set the rules.
They tell the AI about length.
They also specify format and style.
This shapes the final output.
slides.image_prompt: An AI robot with a checklist, a ruler, and a clock icon, representing rules and boundaries.

slides.title: Constraints: Excellent Prompt Example
content: Better Prompt: "Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."

Excellent Prompt (with Constraints): "Write a short blog post, under 400 words, for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city. Use a friendly and enthusiastic tone and end with a question to encourage comments."
slides.narration:
We have a prompt with clarity and context.
Now, let's add constraints.
We'll set a word limit.
We'll also define the tone.
And, we'll ask for a question at the end.
Type this prompt.
'Write a short blog post, under 400 words.
It is for a lifestyle blog.
This blog focuses on sustainable living.
Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car.
This is for someone living in a city.
Use a friendly and enthusiastic tone.
End with a question to encourage comments.'
See the perfect result!
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording: User modifies the prompt to add constraints (word count, tone, ending question). AI generates a perfectly constrained blog post, ending with a question.

slides.title: Bonus Tip: Provide a Persona
content: This is a super-powerful trick.
Tell the AI who to be.
slides.narration:
Here's a bonus tip for you.
Provide a Persona.
This is a powerful trick.
Tell the AI who to be.
It helps the AI adopt a role.
slides.image_prompt: An AI robot wearing different hats or masks, representing various roles like a chef, a doctor, a teacher.

slides.title: Persona: Example
content: Prompt: "Act as an expert travel agent specializing in budget travel. Create a 5-day itinerary for a trip to Rome for a solo traveler who loves history and food."
slides.narration:
Let's see a persona example.
Try this prompt.
'Act as an expert travel agent.
Specialize in budget travel.
Create a 5-day itinerary for a trip to Rome.
This is for a solo traveler.
They love history and food.'
The AI will respond as that persona.
This creates highly relevant answers.
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording: User types the persona prompt. AI generates an itinerary, adopting the language and style of a budget travel agent.
